directions.name: Geometric sans
directions.text: Built from circles and straight lines: clean, modern, a little cool.

directions.name: Humanist sans
directions.text: Shaped like handwriting: warm, open and easy to read for a long time.

directions.name: Rounded sans
directions.text: Soft ends and round shapes: friendly and playful.

directions.name: Neutral sans
directions.text: Plain and Swiss in spirit: it stays out of the way.

directions.name: Characterful sans
directions.text: A sans with a quirk or two: techy, young, memorable.

directions.name: Elegant light sans
directions.text: Fine strokes and open shapes: light, refined, a little vintage.

directions.name: Old-style serif
directions.text: Descended from printed books: warm, calm and classic.

directions.name: Editorial serif
directions.text: Built for long articles: sturdy, clear and serious.

directions.name: High-contrast serif
directions.text: Thick and thin strokes: dramatic, fashionable, luxurious.

directions.name: Soft serif
directions.text: Rounded, old-style serifs with personality: warm and a little quirky.

directions.name: Slab serif
directions.text: Blocky serifs: sturdy, practical, a little industrial.

directions.name: Formal script
directions.text: Calligraphy: invitations, signatures, a touch of ceremony. Never for reading.

directions.name: Casual script
directions.text: Brush and ink in a hurry: personal, lively, handmade.

directions.name: Handwriting
directions.text: Looks written by a person: informal and personal.

directions.name: Condensed display
directions.text: Tall, narrow capitals: posters, headlines, strong statements.

directions.name: Monospace
directions.text: Every letter the same width: technical, precise, a hint of code.
